    AI Overview
    As of late March 2026, 30-year fixed mortgage refinance rates have risen, averaging around 6.47% to 6.57% following a dip in February
    . 15-year fixed loans are averaging approximately 5.65% to 5.90%. Rates for 2026 are generally expected to hover near the 6% range, according to industry forecasts. 
    Current Refinance Rate Averages (March 2026): 
    • 30-Year Fixed: 6.47% - 6.625%
    • 15-Year Fixed: 5.75% - 5.90%
    • 30-Year Fixed FHA/VA: 6.29% - 6.47% 
    Key Considerations: 
    • Market Trends: Rates hit a six-month high in late March 2026 after hitting three-year lows in February.
    • Costs: Refinancing typically costs between 2% and 6% of the total loan amount, notes Liberty Bank.
    • Rule of Thumb: A common rule of thumb for refinancing is to aim for a new rate at least two percentage points lower than your current one, notes Heritage Family Credit Union.
    • Factors: Your credit score, loan type, and equity (down payment) directly impact your rate. 
    Disclaimer: Rates are subject to change rapidly. Consult with lenders for personalized quotes.
